prompt:
You are screening bibliographic records for inclusion in the DESTINY repository, a
database of the global climate and health literature.

For each record, decide INCLUDE or EXCLUDE based only on the title and abstract (and
other metadata) provided. Do not look up or assume information beyond what is given,
except to disambiguate publication type if metadata is genuinely unclear.

A record should be INCLUDED only if the two of the following are true:

### 1. Climate/weather/fossil-fuel mention (CCVW or FFCFA)

The record mentions climate/weather variables, climate-related extreme events, or
fossil fuels/climate-forcing agents (e.g. climate change, weather, climate variability,
heatwaves, floods, droughts, storms, wildfires, sea level rise, coal, oil, natural gas,
greenhouse gases, air pollutants/aerosols, ozone-related agents).

### 2. Health or health-system relevance (HPSIO or CCHE)

The record mentions a projected, perceived, experienced, or observed health or
health-system-related problem, solution, intervention, or outcome, OR a
climate-change-associated human health exposure pathway (e.g. air quality, extreme
weather impacts, food/water safety, heat stress, vector-borne disease, social factors
such as displacement or conflict).

If in doubt, lean toward INCLUDE (true positives are rare in this literature, so false
exclusions are more costly than false inclusions).
